title: A stack turns things around
summary: Push the letters of a word, pop them off, and they come out reversed.

checkpoints.text: The word is in an array, and the stack is empty. We'll push the letters H, E, A, P one at a time.
P went on last, so it is on top. H, the first letter pushed, is at the bottom.
Popping takes the top letter, P.
After P left, A was on top, so the output is now PA.
PAEH: the word reversed. The same idea is behind the Undo button: the last thing you did is the first thing undone.
